name: Yakata no Oku-sama
source:
Main character visits a large Western-style building to deliver a parcel. Noone comes out to him, so he comes in only to find out a girl wearing just a towel. The next day he decides to visit the mansion again since the girl looked so cute. Thus his living in the mansion together with hostess and maids began.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公前往一栋大型西式建筑送包裹。里面没人应门，他便走了进去，结果发现一名只裹着浴巾的女孩。第二天，他因为觉得女孩十分可爱，决定再次前往那座宅邸。就这样，他开始与女主人和女仆们一起住在宅邸里。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
